statement.title: Bonus Statement
statement.managementNote: View your bonus awards, turnover progress, and redemption history
statement.redeemHelpIntro: To get your bonus into your non-cashable balance, you need to meet the turnover required. Here's how:
statement.redeemHelpStep1: Place bets. The amount you bet counts toward your turnover.
statement.redeemHelpStep2: Check the table above. Turnover Met shows your progress; Turnover Left shows what you still need.
statement.redeemHelpStep3: When you've met the requirement, your bonus status will change to Redeemed.
statement.redeemHelpStep4: The bonus will be added to your non-cashable balance automatically.

redeemable.helpStep3: If eligible, the bonus will show up in the list below with the award amount.

redeemable.helpNote: If the coupon is invalid or you're not eligible, you'll see an error message. Make sure you meet any deposit or other requirements for the bonus.

rules.title: Bonus Rules
rules.intro: Please read the following rules before claiming or redeeming any bonus:
items: Bonuses are subject to turnover requirements before they can be withdrawn or transferred to your cashable balance.
Each bonus may have its own expiry date. Unredeemed bonuses may expire if turnover requirements are not met in time.
Only valid coupon codes can be used to claim a bonus. Invalid or expired codes will be rejected.
Bonuses may be restricted to specific sports, casino games, or bet types as defined in the promotion.
The company reserves the right to amend, suspend, or cancel any bonus offer at its discretion.
rules.note: For full details on a specific promotion, check the bonus terms shown when you claim or redeem.

responsibleGaming.title: Responsible Gaming
responsibleGaming.subtitle: We believe in promoting safe and responsible gaming practices.
responsibleGaming.spendMoreThanIntended: Do you spend more time or money than you intended?
responsibleGaming.restless: Do you feel restless or irritable when trying to stop?
responsibleGaming.tryToQuit: Have you tried to cut back but found it difficult?
responsibleGaming.gameAffectsRelationships: Has your gambling affected your relationships or work?
responsibleGaming.borrowedMoney: Have you borrowed money to gamble?
responsibleGaming.gamcareDesc: Free, confidential support and advice for problem gamblers.
responsibleGaming.contact: Contact us at support@platform.com for assistance.
responsibleGaming.heroIntro: We are committed to promoting responsible gaming and providing tools to help you stay in control.

commitment.playerProtectionDesc: We implement measures to protect vulnerable players and prevent underage access
commitment.controlToolsDesc: Easy-to-use tools to help you manage your activity and set limits
commitment.educationDesc: Resources and information to help you understand responsible gaming
commitment.supportResourcesDesc: Access to professional support services and helplines

responsibleGaming.selfAssessmentIntro: Ask yourself these questions to assess your gaming habits:
responsibleGaming.question4: Has gaming caused problems in your relationships or work?
responsibleGaming.question5: Do you use gaming to escape problems or relieve feelings of anxiety?
responsibleGaming.selfAssessmentAdvice: If you answered "yes" to any of these questions, you may want to consider using our control tools or seeking professional help.
responsibleGaming.depositLimitsDesc: Set daily, weekly, or monthly limits on how much you can deposit into your account. These limits help you stay within your budget.
responsibleGaming.sessionTimeLimitsDesc: Set time limits for your gaming sessions. You'll receive reminders when your time limit is approaching.
responsibleGaming.realityChecksDesc: Receive periodic reminders about how long you've been playing and how much you've spent during your session.
responsibleGaming.selfExclusionDesc: Temporarily or permanently exclude yourself from accessing your account. This is a serious decision and can be set for periods ranging from 24 hours to permanent exclusion.
responsibleGaming.accountClosureDesc: Request to permanently close your account. This action is irreversible and will prevent you from accessing our services in the future.
responsibleGaming.tip1: Set a budget before you start and stick to it
responsibleGaming.tip2: Never chase losses - accept that losses are part of gaming
responsibleGaming.tip3: Only play with money you can afford to lose
responsibleGaming.tip4: Take regular breaks and don't play when emotional
responsibleGaming.tip5: Keep track of time and money spent
responsibleGaming.tip6: Don't play under the influence of alcohol or drugs
responsibleGaming.tip7: Remember that gaming is entertainment, not a way to make money
responsibleGaming.gettingHelpIntro: If you or someone you know needs help with problem gaming, there are professional resources available:
responsibleGaming.gamblingTherapyDesc: Global service offering support and advice to anyone affected by problem gaming.
responsibleGaming.contactSupportDesc: Our customer support team is available 24/7 to assist you with setting limits, self-exclusion, or any questions about responsible gaming.
responsibleGaming.underageDesc: Our services are strictly for users aged 18 and over. We have strict age verification procedures in place and take all necessary measures to prevent underage access. If you suspect that someone under 18 is using our services, please contact us immediately.
responsibleGaming.needMoreIntro: If you have questions about responsible gaming or need assistance with our control tools, please don't hesitate to contact us:
